findings.basis: The opening explains artifact lookup, while this section provides manual overrides and an example. Those details establish automatic detection and a fallback, but do not substantiate how broadly detection succeeds.
findings.diagnosis: “Generally smart enough” and “in most situations” imply broad detection reliability without identifying the artifact conventions or conditions that support that expectation. This makes the troubleshooting introduction less precise than the concrete instructions that follow.
findings.quote: Binstall is generally smart enough to auto-detect artifacts in most situations.

findings.basis: The telemetry section identifies the collected fields, their purpose, and links to the dashboard and backend source. Reader interest is not a condition for accessing that source.
findings.diagnosis: This preface delays the backend-source link without adding information about what readers can inspect there or when it matters.
